posts.title: Wouldn't It Be Good (Album Version)
posts.description: When I was about 15, maybe 16, my mother and her partner owned a Fish and Chip shop . That room there on the right of the building was my bedroom. Over the back fence there was a block of flats. In the end flat, lived a woman, possibly in her mid or late 20s. I saw her a few times over the fence. posts.title: Give me back the rear mono button of the late 80s
posts.description: In the very late 80s and early 90s I did a lot of travelling around Aotearoa New Zealand in Avis rental cars, mostly Toyota Corollas and Coronas. They all came equipped with Alpine car audio that had a really good button for rear mono. So you had stereo up front and punchy weight from the rear parcel shelf speakers.
